source_boundaries.author_note: Twelve source discrepancies or interpretation/implementation boundaries, not twelve asserted defects. No silent fixes in Chinese source/quiz/code/output. Runtime references are fresh author observations.

author_12.source_fact: Canonical docs title is longer than quiz title.
author_12.translation_treatment: Translation follows docs long title; quiz untouched.

author_12.source_fact: Illustrative score is impact * uncertainty + irreversibility, not universal. Example order is 27/25/9.
author_12.translation_treatment: No invented universal formula; values preserved in source artifacts.

author_12.source_fact: range membership admits True and 5.0, rejecting False/0/6/1.5; type annotation/error text are not strict runtime integer validation.
author_12.translation_treatment: Characterization only, no source patch or stricter translated promise.

author_12.source_fact: Nonempty evidence, including whitespace or an unverified assertion, labels tested and excludes selection; credibility is not checked.
author_12.translation_treatment: Tested is not translated as proven true.

author_12.source_fact: Ranking uses descending score then statement; next selection uses first input among tied open max candidates after evidence filtering.
author_12.translation_treatment: No claim that selector uses alphabetical tie breaking.

author_12.source_fact: Lab has selector functionality, but main only writes/prints ranked JSON. Original tests call selector.
author_12.translation_treatment: No claimed selector output from main.

author_12.source_fact: Output derives from __file__, so changing cwd alone cannot isolate writes.
author_12.translation_treatment: Full temporary lesson copy included outputs; author source untouched.

author_12.source_fact: Experiment/remediation descriptions are stored strings, not executed actions or permissions.
author_12.translation_treatment: No replay, interview, production integration, or remediation executed by the program.

author_12.source_fact: Useful experiment includes pass, fail, and ambiguous evidence decisions; a demo alone is insufficient.
author_12.translation_treatment: All three branches retained; no automatic-confirmation interpretation.

author_12.source_fact: Authority remains broad permitted access/action, with three reversible-before-irreversible examples.
author_12.translation_treatment: No invented administrator-role requirement or permission grant.

author_12.source_fact: Feasibility differs from viability: data/constraints versus cost/ownership/operation.
author_12.translation_treatment: Five separate categories and questions retained.

author_12.source_fact: Next lesson uses the map to choose the smallest decisive-evidence slice; this does not mean a build already occurred.
author_12.translation_treatment: Path exact; final sentence explicitly preserves sufficient-to-decide evidence.

peer_findings.observation: docs uses longer canonical title than quiz; preserve docs title and do not rewrite quiz.
risk_score range membership permits True and integral floats despite integer wording in ValueError; characterization required, not a translation fix.
tested iff evidence truthy; no credibility, relevance, threshold, or truth evaluation.
prioritize ties sort statement alphabetically; next_experiment max selects first equally scored open input.
main only writes/prints ranked JSON; does not call or display next_experiment. Lab narration refers to helper capability, while exercise does not name an invocation to display next choice.
main writes based on __file__; changed cwd alone cannot isolate output.
sample tests are inert text; running code does not replay incidents, interview people, grant authority, or perform remediation.
Mermaid has support/reject branches while prose explicitly also discusses ambiguous evidence; preserve both source surfaces unchanged, not an invented diagram repair.

next_experiment filters truthy-evidence entries before scoring, so a tested entry with an invalid dimension is skipped; prioritize validates all entries and raises. Empty inputs yield []/None and all-tested input yields None. Independent 19-assumption characterization verified this without changing source.

Original site parser creates empty IDs for all 11 Chinese headings. Offline execution returns BLOCKED_SOURCE_RENDERER despite process exit 0. This is an existing renderer limitation; actual GFM/browser verification remains outstanding.

technical_summary.score: impact * uncertainty + irreversibility; three separate dimensions 1..5; illustrative, not universal
technical_summary.status: tested is based only on evidence truthiness, never credibility or proof
technical_summary.ties: prioritize: descending score then statement; next_experiment: first input among equal open maxima
technical_summary.concepts: Value/outcome, usability, feasibility, viability and safety remain separate; authority denotes unsafe access/actions without inventing an administrator role
technical_summary.execution: main writes and prints ranked JSON only; selector exists and tests call it; stored test strings never executed
